name: Lightless Capital
description: Hundreds of years ago, Nod-Krai too experienced a golden age, where adventurers and treasure hunters gathered in droves at the prosperous city that bore the weight of humanity's arrogant dreams, its steel sinews and iron bones reflecting industrial and technological glory at the very edge of the world. Then calamity descended, and objects both living and not were dragged equally into the darkness, while past vibrance and opulence were buried by the ruthless march of time.

tabs.name: Domain of Mastery: Fallen City I
tabs.description:
The corpse of a once prosperous city that later fell into ruin, its enigmatic structure hinting at its future, cut off from remembrance.
If you can destroy the foes that dwell within this place, you may gain insight and enlightenment that could improve your Talents.
